description: This PHP source file is part of a web-based UI that provides diagnostic and configuration controls for VoIP global parameters, including logging level and SIP client control. It includes PHP logic, HTML markup, CSS styling, and JavaScript for client-side interactivity and AJAX communication with server-side scripts.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves current global diagnostic parameters such as logging level and SIP process status.
